digest.component_or_area: Janitor plan recovery and approval phase
propositions: Five approved recovered repair proposals (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed decision-ready briefs before becoming implementation stories, rooted in durable closed-tracker recovery authority and checkout-local research artifacts.

Each RP independently needs situation mapping, intended end state, preserved hard-won behavior, newly proven reachable failures, migration/rollback considerations, and remaining maintainer-only choices recorded in decision-ready briefs.

RP-02 owns ordered exact-match binding retirement recovery at explicit live-operation boundaries with read-only construction/load/preview, RP-03 owns TicketPlan orchestration and Jira failure classification with scoped finite-pass fuse, and RP-04/RP-05/RP-06 own composition, CLI routing, and unified review-gate policy respectively.

All substantive claims must cite repository evidence, tests, tracker history, and commit records; every behavior delta must be explicitly marked for maintainer approval rather than silently treated as an invariant.

Implementation-ready acceptance requires operator-attested decision-ready briefs for each RP, citation/decision-queue audit, durable completion comment linking local briefs to recovery authority, and verification that no production code or tracked files were changed during research phase.
